speaker: Mr Darryl David
text: asked the Minister for Education (a) whether the number of Primary school students requiring counselling for mental health issues have risen in the last five years; and (b) how are such students managed as they transition into Secondary school and beyond.

speaker: Mr Darryl David (Ang Mo Kio)
text: I think the Minister of State mentioned that such information will be sensitively managed and shared on a need-to-know basis.

speaker: Mr Darryl David (Ang Mo Kio)
text: Could the Minister of State further explain, with regard to even sharing the information beyond MOE, for example, in the future with other Government agencies, how is that information managed and accessed?

speaker: Mr Darryl David (Ang Mo Kio)
text: For example, if a male student should need to get mental support, mental healthcare, throughout his scholastic journey, and when he enlists in the Army, would MINDEF have accessibility to that kind of information, which is typically I am assuming, held by MOE.

speaker: Mr Darryl David (Ang Mo Kio)
text: Could the Minister of State please provide some clarity on issues like that?

speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
text: We are very concerned about the continuity of mental health care and support for our young people.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
text: Just a quick question for the Minister of State.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
text: She mentioned earlier that the number has been stable.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
text: Can I just enquire from the Minister of State what is that number, particularly, for the last year?
